**Verdict: KEEP**

The CREATE card (bottom-right) successfully meets all criteria: (1) the watch face contains only tick marks and hands with zero digits or number-like glyphs; (2) it clearly communicates "create an activity from watch stats by drawing a route" through the combination of the analog clock, orange dotted path, and drawing pencil; and (3) it maintains perfect stylistic consistency with the other three cards featuring the same paper texture background, ink linework style, and single orange accent color.
